fields.description: Slot status marker byte; 0xFF in both live blocks. FUN_080182c4 copies save+4 onward into RAM, FUN_08018384 gates the whole block on the DODG magic.
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 copies save buffer +4 (0x94 bytes) to RAM; FUN_08018384 validates block magic before use; baseline save+0x05 is 0xFF in both slots.
fields.name: save_slot_status

fields.description: Game config/options value at the tail of the 0x94-byte settings block (first options byte).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 copies save+4..+0x97 (0x94 bytes) as the settings block into RAM; baseline save+0x8C is 3 in both slots.
fields.name: config_option_a

fields.description: Game config/options value at the tail of the 0x94-byte settings block (second options byte).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 copies save+4..+0x97 (0x94 bytes) as the settings block into RAM; baseline save+0x8D is 1 in both slots.
fields.name: config_option_b

fields.description: Five-byte config/mode flag run closing the 0x94-byte settings block (all 0x03 in the live save).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 copies save+4..+0x97 (0x94 bytes) as the settings block into RAM; baseline save+0x90..+0x94 is 03 03 03 03 03 in both slots.
fields.name: config_option_block

fields.description: Team 0 table/rank index byte (entry+2 of the 0x90-byte team record). Values across the 15 entries form the permutation 0..13 plus 0xFF for the player-side entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 loads fifteen 0x90-byte team records from save+0x98; FUN_08017d64 sorts that team array; baseline entry+2 values are a 0..13 permutation with team 0 at 0xFF.
fields.name: team0_table_index

fields.description: Team 0 paired record halfwords (entry+4/+5, e.g. wins and its shadow copy). FUN_08017e24 syncs +4 into +5 for all 15 teams every update.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017e24 executes *(team+5) = *(team+4) for all 15 entries of the 0x90-stride team array loaded by FUN_080182c4 from save+0x98; baseline save+0x9C..+0x9D is 09 09.
fields.name: team0_record_primary

fields.description: Team 0 standings sort key (entry+6). FUN_08017d64 quicksorts the 15-team table on (signed char)(entry+6)/2.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017d64 quicksorts the 0x90-stride team array on *(char *)(base + team*0x90 + 6) / 2 loaded by FUN_080182c4 from save+0x98; baseline save+0x9E is 9.
fields.name: team0_standings_key

fields.description: Team 0 active/unlocked flag (entry+8): 1 for the 10 active teams, 0 for the 5 locked entries in the live save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 loads fifteen 0x90-byte team records from save+0x98; baseline entry+8 is 1 for entries 0-5,8,10,11 and 0 for entries 6,7,12,13,14.
fields.name: team0_active_flag

fields.description: Team 0 first attribute halfword of the stat table starting at entry+0x0C (46 in the live save).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 loads fifteen 0x90-byte team records from save+0x98 into RAM via func_0x08050abc; baseline save+0xA4..+0xA5 is 2E 00 (46 LE).
fields.name: team0_attr_a

fields.description: Mirror of config_option_a in backup slot B (file offset 0x1B24 + 0x8C). Both slots are byte-identical in the live save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 falls back to slot index +3 (file 0x1B24) via FUN_08018384 when slot A fails; baseline slot B save+0x8C is 3, identical to slot A.
fields.name: config_option_a_mirror

fields.description: Mirror of team0_record_primary in backup slot B (file offset 0x1B24 + 0x9C).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 falls back to slot index +3 (file 0x1B24) via FUN_08018384; FUN_08017e24 syncs entry+4 into +5; baseline slot B bytes are 09 09, identical to slot A.
fields.name: team0_record_primary_mirror

fields.description: Mirror of team0_standings_key in backup slot B (file offset 0x1B24 + 0x9E).
fields.evidence: FUN_080182c4 falls back to slot index +3 (file 0x1B24) via FUN_08018384; FUN_08017d64 sorts on entry+6; baseline slot B value is 9, identical to slot A.
fields.name: team0_standings_key_mirror

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'DODG' block magic, verified in both slots
